title: Senior Annuitant Protection Provision: Caps on the Corrected Partial-Withdrawal Charge Percentage, Deferred Fixed Annuities
content:
On Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contracts, the percentage at which a corrected partial-withdrawal charge is worked is limited by the annuitant's age on the withdrawal date.

## Provision

The schedule-year percentage of a corrected partial-withdrawal charge is capped at **2% (0.02)** where the annuitant was aged **75** or more on the withdrawal date, capped at **3% (0.03)** where the annuitant was aged **70** or more but under 75 on the withdrawal date, and left uncapped where the annuitant was under 70 on that date. A cap is a ceiling: the capped percentage is the lower of the schedule-year percentage and the cap, so a cap never raises a percentage. The result is the capped percentage of the charge.

## Input, judgement, result

| Annuitant's age on the withdrawal date | Ceiling | Schedule-year percentage 6% becomes | Schedule-year percentage 1% becomes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 75 or more | 2% | 2% | 1% |
| 70 to 74 | 3% | 3% | 1% |
| Under 70 | None | 6% | 1% |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- Annuitant aged 74 on the withdrawal date: 3% ceiling. Aged 75 on that date: 2% ceiling.
- Annuitant aged 69 on the withdrawal date: no ceiling. Aged 70: 3% ceiling.
- An annuitant whose 75th birthday falls the day after the withdrawal date was 74 on the withdrawal date.

Ages are whole years last birthday from the annuitant's date of birth, taken on the withdrawal date.
